tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias. Brand color: primary buttons, links, selected states. Light themes: brand 600 (emerald 700) with white text; dark themes: brand 400 with brand-950 text. More contrast: brand 800 / brand 300, 7:1+ on `surface` and `primary-subtle`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `primary` (one step darker in light themes, lighter in dark). More contrast: brand 900 / brand 200.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Alias. Text and icons on `primary` fills (white in light themes, brand 950 in dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary button fill; hover fill for outline and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Hover state of `secondary`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The keyboard-highlighted item in a list: Menu items, Combobox and TimePicker options, the Sidebar's current page. One step stronger than `secondary` in light (about 1.3:1 on `surface`); in dark it shares `secondary`'s zinc-700 (1.7:1 on `surface`, 1.4:1 on `surface-overlay`), so a `primary` bar keeps 3:1 on it in every brand, paired with a 2px `primary` bar at the item's start. Text on it keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Alias. The fill while a row, tab, day or page button is held down (`:active`): one step past its hover. `text` keeps 7:1+ on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alias. Page and card background (white light, zinc-900 dark).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary panels, sidebars, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. A raised card (Card `elevated`). One step up from `surface` in dark, where a shadow doesn't show.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Alias. Anything in the top layer: Menu, Popover, Dialog, Drawer, Toast and the Combobox, DatePicker and TimePicker lists.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Alias. Background of text inputs, selects and other form fields.

tokens.name: field-readonly
tokens.usage: Alias. Background of a read-only or disabled form field: a step flatter than `field` (zinc-50 in light, the page's zinc-900 in dark), so it reads as not editable while its `field-border` still outlines it.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Alias. Border of form fields. 3:1+ against `field` and `surface` in every theme, as WCAG 1.4.11 requires for a control's boundary.

tokens.name: field-border-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Field border on hover.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Alias. Placeholder text in form fields (4.5:1+ on `field`). Placeholders are hints, never labels.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Alias. The dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers (zinc-900 at 50% in light themes, zinc-950 at 70% in dark).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Alias. Contrasting blocks: tooltips, inverse banners.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Alias. Body text and headings on `surface`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary text, captions, placeholders (4.5:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Alias. Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Alias. Default borders and dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Alias. Emphasised dividers and outlines. Form fields use `field-border`, which meets the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

tokens.name: border-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. A raised card's edge: invisible in light (white on white), a 1px lighter edge in dark.

tokens.name: border-overlay
tokens.usage: Alias. The edge of a top-layer surface. In dark it is one step stronger than `border`, so a menu stands off the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Alias. Keyboard focus outline, in the brand hue (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme). More contrast: brand 700 / brand 300.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Alias. Success icons and fills (3:1). For success text use `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Success alert / badge background.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Alias. Success text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `success-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Alias. Warning icons and fills; put dark text on it. For warning text use `warning-text`.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Warning alert / badge background.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Alias. Warning text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `warning-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Alias. Errors, destructive buttons; white text on it (4.8:1). For error text on dark surfaces use `red-400`.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Hover / pressed state of `danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Alias. Text and icons on `danger` fills.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Error alert / badge background.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Alias. Destructive text and icons on `surface`, `danger-subtle` and its hover (5.3:1+ in every theme).

tokens.name: danger-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Alias. Hover fill for destructive secondary, outline and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Alias. Border of a destructive outline button.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Alias. Informational icons and text.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Alias. Info alert / badge background.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Alias. Info text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `info-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Alias. A visited link in reading content (Prose): a shade apart from primary, 4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-muted` in every theme.

scripts.note: Noto Sans Arabic is in the sans stack. Marks above and below the letters need a taller line: 1.6 at the least.
Noto Sans Devanagari is in the sans stack. Vowel signs above the headline and below the letters need 1.5 at the least.
Noto Sans Thai is in the sans stack. Tone marks stack above vowels: 1.5 at the least (the font's own height is 1.51).
Han characters are drawn differently in each language, so the font follows lang. Square characters read best with 1.5 at the least.
As Japanese. After Simplified Chinese, so zh-TW wins over zh.

tokens.name: ease-in-expo
tokens.usage: Accelerates hard: barely moves, then gone. Rarely right for UI.

tokens.name: ease-in-out-cubic
tokens.usage: Smooth start and finish: something that stays on screen and changes (`ease-move`).

tokens.name: ease-in-out-quart
tokens.usage: A pronounced start and finish: a large panel or page-level change.

tokens.name: ease-in-out-expo
tokens.usage: The most pronounced start and finish: a deliberate, dramatic move. Use rarely.

tokens.name: ease-out-back
tokens.usage: Decelerates past the end by about 4%, then comes back: something small popping into place (`ease-pop`).

tokens.name: ease-spring-soft
tokens.usage: A damped spring (damping ratio 0.85) that barely overshoots, written as `linear()`: something released that comes to rest naturally. Generated by `tools/tokens/spring.mjs`.

tokens.name: ease-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: A damped spring (damping ratio 0.6) that overshoots by about 9% and settles, written as `linear()`: a press let go springing back (`ease-spring`). Generated by `tools/tokens/spring.mjs`.

tokens.name: ease-elastic
tokens.usage: A loose spring (damping ratio 0.3) that overshoots by about 37% and wobbles a few times before it settles, written as `linear()`. tokens.name: motion-ripple-fade
tokens.usage: A press ripple fading once it has spread.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: The gap between items of a group arriving one after another, for a group seen now and then (a page's cards, a first list of results), never one opened over and over (menu items, toasts). Each item waits its index times this.

tokens.name: motion-stagger-limit
tokens.usage: The longest any item of a staggered group waits, so a long list still arrives within a moment: items past the sixth arrive together.

tokens.name: motion-sequence
tokens.usage: The offset between the steps of one entrance, so they read as a sequence: a dialog or drawer’s backdrop starts, then its panel. Exits don’t sequence; everything leaves together.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Something appearing: quick off the mark, then a long smooth landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Something leaving: at full speed from the first frame, then easing off as it fades, so a closed surface is out of the way at once. An ease-in starts slowly, and the first frames after a close are the ones people watch.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Something that stays on screen and changes: a thumb sliding, a panel resizing, a color changing. A smooth start and finish.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Something arriving at a new value or let go by the hand: a fill, a slide, a drawer dropped. Most of the travel at once, then a long glide to rest.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Something small popping into place: a check mark, a count, a dot. Overshoots a touch, then settles.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A press let go springing back, or a thumb or indicator landing: a real spring that overshoots and settles. Pair it with a duration about twice the motion it answers (a press of `motion-press` springs back over `motion-change-md`).

tokens.name: ease-fling
tokens.usage: Something the hand let go of mid-motion carrying on to rest: a drawer or carousel slide flicked. It starts at three times its average speed, so a settle timed as 3 × distance ÷ the hand’s speed starts exactly at that speed and slows from there (`settleTime()` in the components).

tokens.name: ease-celebrate
tokens.usage: A small, rare moment worth celebrating: a success check landing, a count bumping, an item snapping into its slot after a drag. Wobbles, then settles. Give it about three times the motion it answers (`motion-change-lg` or longer) so the wobble reads, and never use it for menus, dialogs, page moves or repeated actions. Off under reduced motion.
